title: amyrsia limbata
intro: Amyrsia limbata, commonly known as Chinese angelica or Chinese angelica tree, is a plant species that belongs to the family Araliaceae. The health benefits of Amyrsia limbata include its use in traditional medicine to treat fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions are attributed to its anti-inflammatory, antiviral, and antioxidant properties, making it useful for reducing swelling and fighting off infections.
